descripcion_geo: Oasis and caravan city in northwestern Saudi Arabia (present-day Al-'Ula). Center of the incense trade between Arabia and the Mediterranean.
importancia_estrategica: Key knot of the incense route; The prophets mention it as a commercial power in the south.

historias.descripcion: Ezekiel mentions the Dedanites as merchants who supply Tyre with chairs and rugs.
Jeremiah includes Dedan in the oracles against the Arab nations who will drink the cup of divine judgment.

historias.titulo: Isaiah and the caravans of Dedan
historias.descripcion: Isaiah mentions the caravans of Dedan that take refuge in the forests of Arabia fleeing from the enemy.

personajes.descripcion: He mentioned Dedán products in the Tyre trade description.
He pronounced an oracle against Dedan in the judgments on the nations.
He described the fleeing Dedanite caravans as a sign of judgment on Arabia.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Dedan: relevant geographical region in the Old Testament.

judaismo.descripcion: Dedan was the main junction of the incense route in Arabia; the prophets use it as a symbol of luxury and commerce that will also fall under divine judgment.
judaismo.significado_teologico: Dedan was the main junction of the incense route in Arabia; the prophets use it as a symbol of luxury and commerce that will also fall under divine judgment.
